nextLayerName: Security and isolation overhead without reducing protection
reason: Integrated the observation-only PowerProfile truth map into UX-ROM using documented PowrProf APIs for the active scheme, separate AC/DC user preferences, effective runtime mode, and five AC/DC processor-policy values, plus bounded Intel Dynamic Tuning ownership and observer calibration. Five passive lab snapshots were consistent: Balanced base scheme, AC Best Performance, DC Best Efficiency, effective Max Performance, AC online, and Battery Saver off. All five processor settings were readable for AC and DC; observer median/p95 were 1.2007/1.6947 ms. The full relevant suite passed 122 tests. No power plan, processor setting, OEM service, driver, registry value, policy, reboot state, or Windows setting changed, and no performance-gain claim was made.
